correctness.rationale: For A_r and norm^p=wo∫|f|^p_outer+wi∫|f|^p_inner, 0<p<∞, restrict to T=ψ(f∘φ) with φ annulus automorphism and ψ,ψ^{-1} bounded holomorphic. For inversion φ=e^{iθ}r/z, comparing isometry on shifted Laurent polynomials z^nP and taking n→+∞/−∞ isolates the two boundary mass identities. Perturbations P=1+εz^m and Fourier uniqueness yield boundary moduli |ψ|^p=wi/wo outer, wo/wi inner. Bounded harmonic log|ψ| has unique radial interpolation; single-valuedness forces integer k and ψ=cz^k, with wi/wo=r^(−kp/2), |c|=r^(−k/2). Rotations force constant |c|=1. Change-of-circle variables proves sufficiency and inverse weighted-composition proves surjectivity. Independently checked 36 exact p=2 rational Laurent-polynomial norm identities; these are finite tests, not the argument for all p.
residual_risks: Infinite theorem not derived from finite checks; reconstructed written proof supplies its generality.
